name: SaaS Commercialization, Billing, Licensing, Entitlements, White Label & Customer Operations
commercial_position: Vendor-neutral. Specific payment, tax, email, domain, CRM/support and marketplace providers remain adapter decisions.
principles: Commercial entitlement never overrides security authorization
Issued financial records are corrected through governed adjustments
White label is tenant/reseller scoped and security-safe
Enterprise overrides are explicit, effective-dated and auditable
Operational tenant data is not silently destroyed by billing lifecycle changes
